optical.timing: delay <= 30 ns, pulse-width distortion <= +-4 ns: negligible against microsecond gates
optical.housings: 6 Versatile Link housings (18.8, 12.19, 7.62) mm: at the neck and at the hinge / handle, not in the 18 mm bore
findings: the fibre would follow the cord flex's rolling loop inside an 18.6 mm bore: at most 8.2 mm loop radius against 15 mm for repeated bending (25 mm static): it does not fit the telescope (32 mm bore needed)
gain if it did: flex 18.2 -> 16.3 mm, 6 conductors and the digital-edge coupling into the REF pairs removed; cost 0.41-0.60 W (scan runtime 5.18 -> 5.02 h)
galvanic isolation is only partial: power, TX strips and REF pairs stay copper
where it fits: a straight, static run (e.g. handle to a hinge-mounted board) or a free-space IR link down a clear tube (not modeled)

central_bore.feasible_in: the innermost (lowest) tube only: every other tube's bore must stay clear for the tube that slides in it

long_flex_boards.echo_rule: metal boards at s >= 375 mm from the head stay below 0.5 x gate noise for a 5 K step (rf2_system echoes, TXD-class metal); the outer tube spans s 410-790 mm
long_flex_boards.inside_flats: the inner flats of the outer and middle tubes are swept by the sliding tube (clearance 1.3 mm): only flex with parts under about 1 mm would fit, at wear risk

findings: same across-flats: hex tubes 182 g vs square 210 g, tip sag 4.72 vs 3.55 mm (hex is lighter and slightly softer: less material in the corners)
equal mass: hex across-flats x1.148 (35.6, 29.8, 24.1 mm), sag 3.11 mm vs square 3.55 mm
inner flats: hex 6 x 10.7 mm vs square 4 x 18.6 mm; the whole 15.7 mm cord flex fits one square face, not one hex face: on a hex it splits by group onto separate faces
TX strips and REF pairs on opposite hex faces: 8.86 pF/m vs 18.99 pF/m side by side on the flex (gap 5.3 mm)
a central bore with webs works only in the innermost tube; it would carry a fibre or a coax, but the fibre still cannot cross the rolling loop
long flex boards: the outside flats of the upper tube give 408 cm2 (square 471 cm2) at s 410-790 mm, past the 375 mm echo distance: room for the TXD as a long board under a cover
the flex groups bonded to the inner tube's faces move with it; the slack for the 550 mm travel still needs the rolling loop (or a coil cord) in the upper tubes

rule_rows.rule: POF repeated-bend radius vs the rolling-loop radius available in the inner bore
hex (same AF) tip sag vs the square profiles' sag
HV lane group (TX strips + edges) vs one hex inner flat
